name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: We should adopt a 2-pixel solid focus ring with a 2-pixel outer glow at 20% opacity. This decision provides a clear visual indicator for keyboard navigation, which is essential for users who rely on assistive technologies, while also being subtle enough not to overwhelm users with visual distractions. By choosing a 2-pixel focus ring, we're accepting the trade-off of slightly increasing visual clutter, but it's a necessary compromise to ensure that our interface is usable by everyone, particularly those with visual impairments. This design choice also aligns with the Playwright MCP's emphasis on clear and consistent visual cues.

name: Reader
text: The 2px ring + 2px glow bleeds at 125% zoom—it’s not just "slightly less professional," it fails WCAG 1.4.10 (Reflow) at 200% zoom. Use a 1px ring with a 1px glow at 30% opacity instead. Test with Playwright MCP’s keyboard navigation suite and confirm no overlap or loss of focus visibility at 200% zoom.

name: Ramp
text:
Adopt a 1-pixel solid focus ring with a 1-pixel outer glow at 30% opacity. This keeps the visual indicator crisp at 200% zoom, passing WCAG 1.4.10 (Reflow) while still providing clear keyboard navigation feedback. The trade-off is slightly less visual prominence at standard zoom, but that’s acceptable because the ring remains visible and the glow improves contrast for low-vision users. Test with Playwright MCP’s keyboard navigation suite to confirm no overlap or loss of focus visibility.

name: Reader
text: The 1px ring + 1px glow at 30% opacity risks fading into the background for users with mild visual impairments or in high-glare conditions. A better alternative: test a 1.5px ring with a 1px glow at 25% opacity—it keeps crispness at 200% zoom while maintaining visibility. Settle the argument with Playwright MCP’s keyboard navigation suite and a 200% zoom contrast check against WCAG 2.1 AA.

name: Access
text: DECISION: Adopt a 1.5px solid focus ring with a 1px outer glow at 25% opacity—tested at 200% zoom via Playwright MCP’s keyboard suite by Ramp by EOD.
